description: Make one controlled HTTP API call. Managed operation: call with op:start; the result arrives on a later turn as an operation_result containing the HTTP status and a bounded response-body excerpt. Use auth_ref to name an environment variable containing a bearer token; never put credentials in args or headers.

op.description: Operation to perform. 'start' makes the request and finishes immediately; 'poll' exists only for managed-operation contract completeness.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL. Required with op:start.

headers.description: Optional non-secret headers as 'Name: value' strings. Never put credentials here; use auth_ref.

auth_ref.description: Optional environment-variable name containing the bearer token. The variable name is logged; its value is never placed in action args or curl argv.
